A beer tracker that takes one tap

Most beer trackers make you search for the beer, pick the bar and type a note. ontap does it in one tap from your home or lock screen, so you actually keep it up.

By the ontap team · 23 October 2026

How it works

  1. Add the widget to your home or lock screen.
  2. Tap it when you order. ontap logs the beer and the bar you're at.
  3. That's it. Add a photo or tag friends later if you want.

What you get back

  • Your nights, mapped: every spot you've been, filling up over time.
  • Friends who are out: a shared map and a live list of who's out right now.
  • Squads: race your group week by week, month by month.
  • 30+ badges and Mayors: log the most at your local and you're its Mayor.
  • Last Call: a monthly recap of your nights out, made for sharing.

Private by default

Only friends you add see where you've logged. Turn location sharing off whenever you like, and you only appear on the Global feed if you choose to.

FAQ

Is ontap free?

Yes, ontap is free on iPhone. An optional ontap Pro with extras is on the way.

Is ontap on Android?

Not yet; ontap is iPhone only for now.

Does ontap work on the lock screen?

Yes. The lock screen widget logs a beer without unlocking into the app.
